#final full paper processing for 16S analysis

```{r}
#Activate
library(qiime2R)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tibble)
library(decontam)
library (BiocManager)
```

#upload data
```{r}
#create phyloseq objects
B_ps_raw <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "C:/Users/laure/OneDrive - McMaster University/Kalan_lab_CO-OP/Renovoderm/16S/processed_16Sdata/trimmed/cluster/table-dada2_clust97.qza", 
  taxonomy = "C:/Users/laure/OneDrive - McMaster University/Kalan_lab_CO-OP/Renovoderm/16S/processed_16Sdata/trimmed/cluster/TaxonomyFinal_clust97_gtdb.qza", 
  metadata = "C:/Users/laure/OneDrive - McMaster University/Kalan_lab_CO-OP/Renovoderm/metadata/Renovoderm_metadata_clean.txt")

#check 
print(B_ps_raw)

#view each phyloseq object
B_tax_table = as.data.frame(tax_table(B_ps_raw))
B_meta_table = as.data.frame(sample_data(B_ps_raw))
B_otu_table = as.data.frame(otu_table(B_ps_raw))
```
#view if top features across samples are identified
```{r}
#isolate otu table
feature_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(B_ps_raw))

#count cells in rows wtih values greater than zero(i.e how many samples have that feature)
clean_row <- rowSums(feature_counts >0)

#organize into descending order
ordered_features <- clean_row[order(-clean_row)]

#check data
ordered_features

#convert to dataframe
counts_df <- data.frame(sample_counts = ordered_features)

#view df
counts_df

#isolate taxonomy data
tax_data <- data.frame(tax_table(B_ps_raw))

#merge taxonomy table and feature counts
all_feature_count <- merge(tax_data,counts_df, by="row.names", all=TRUE)

#rename first column header
colnames(all_feature_count)[1] <"OTU_ID"

#remove NA
c_feature_count <- all_feature_count %>% filter(!is.na(sample_counts))

#organize in descending order
clean_feature_counts <- c_feature_count[order(-c_feature_count$sample_counts),]

#check samples
clean_feature_counts
```
#Add genus names for missing top taxa; identified using BLAST+ on the NCBI website
```{r}
B_ps_updated <- B_ps_raw

#create otu-to-genus mapping data frame
B_otu_to_genus<-data.frame(
  OTU_ID = c("c2594f1ec76737e5296cf25021e2bbd9","a254712cee74b64452c08384146faf6a", "3bd0a301dcab1808e9f6224b72fe52e1", "8a4525e6390fc968d73850ec594c3e9a", "8ae1f6e4244b4a94be7a2e4106cba72f", "cc83e58db632318dbb91bbaa5ca22968", "fbc55529321453d010d3554729c2b22b", "099d5bc8846138b02376b961cf8f34e6", "0995ece489598caed5121ade0a870dee","ba0f498208470462c00507bb168104be","e865219f81b517488a5f155488d02391","3ab9348c7b30c38fa1917c8b22e843b5", "a586f6feb230d749ca4ea8422684383e", "b30ccc443ecf0c55e90abbcbbc7d88ef", "044f2a9f6ca991100b2b9087ac35fad4", "24274e30457e597001a1817901ad1818", "6afce98e6cd76d03f99392780daf9bc9"), 
  Genus = c("Kocuria", "Enterococcus", "Serratia", "Paracoccus", "f_Rhizobiaceae", "f_Burkholderiaceae", "Raoutella", "c_Saccharofermentanales","Peptoniphilus","Porphyromonas","Pseudomonas","Peptoniphilus", "Porphyromonas", "Moraxella", "Hymphomicrobium", "Pseudomonas", "f_Propionibacteriaceae")) 

#extract the taxonomy table from the phyloseq object
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(B_ps_updated))

#update the Genus column based on the OTU-to-Genus mapping
tax_table_df$Genus <- ifelse(
  rownames(tax_table_df) %in% B_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID, 
  B_otu_to_genus$Genus[match(rownames(tax_table_df), B_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID)], 
  tax_table_df$Genus)

#replace the updated taxonomy table in the phyloseq object
tax_table(B_ps_updated) <- as.matrix(tax_table_df)

#view the updated taxonomy table for the specific OTUs
tax_table_df[B_otu_to_genus$OTU_ID, ]

B_ps_updated
```
#Only keep bacteria
```{r}
#create copy
ps_bacteria <- B_ps_updated

#access taxonomy
B_taxonomy <- data.frame(tax_table(ps_bacteria))

#see how many are not bacteria
taxa_non_bacteria <- subset(B_taxonomy, Kingdom != "d__Bacteria")
print("how many non bacteria")
nrow(taxa_non_bacteria)

#keep only bacteria
B_taxonomy_filtered <- subset(B_taxonomy, Kingdom == "d__Bacteria")

#how many removed
print("how many removed")
nrow(B_taxonomy) - nrow(B_taxonomy_filtered)

#update phyloseq
tax_table(ps_bacteria) <- as.matrix(B_taxonomy_filtered)
ps_bacteria
```

#View distribution of taxonomic identification
```{r}
#exrtact taxa table
B_unidentified_taxa <- tax_table(ps_bacteria)

#count total identified at each taxonomic rank
B_identified <-colSums(!is.na(B_unidentified_taxa))

#make new df with identified counts at each rank
B_labeled_counts<-data.frame(Identified = B_identified)
B_taxonomy_set<- rownames_to_column(B_labeled_counts, var="Taxonomy Level")
B_taxonomy_set

#extract value for "Kingdom" in the "Identified" column for total
B_total<-B_taxonomy_set$Identified[B_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level` =="Kingdom"]

#calculate percent of identified taxa at each level, relative to kingdom level
x<-B_taxonomy_set$Identified
B_taxonomy_set$`Percent Identified`<- x/B_total*100

#set order in taxonomic level column
B_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level`<-factor(B_taxonomy_set$`Taxonomy Level`, levels = c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"))

#plot results
B_taxonomy_graph <- ggplot(B_taxonomy_set, aes(x=`Taxonomy Level`, y=`Percent Identified`))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="steelblue")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "Percent of features identified at each taxonomic level", x= "Taxonomic Level", y= "Percent Identified")+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = -90))
B_taxonomy_graph
```

#remove empty samples (PREP FOR FILTERING BY PREVALENCE)
```{r}
B_remove_empty1_ps<-ps_bacteria

#isolate otu table
otu_table<-otu_table(B_remove_empty1_ps)

#view empty samples (won't run when no empty samples)
empty_samples<-otu_table[,colSums(otu_table)<1]
colnames(empty_samples)

#remove empty samples
clean_otu1<- otu_table[,colSums(otu_table)>0]

#look at feature and sample distribution
print("feature counts distribution")
summary(rowSums(clean_otu1))

print("feature counts in samples distribution")
summary(colSums(clean_otu1))

#update phyloseq
otu_table(B_remove_empty1_ps)<-clean_otu1
B_remove_empty1_ps
```

#Filter by prevalence
#check otu counts
```{r}
#extract otu table
otu_table <- otu_table(B_remove_empty1_ps)

#Count number of samples each OTU is present in
otu_count <- rowSums(otu_table >0)

#select OTU IDs present in exactly 1 sample and count how many
unique_otus <- names(otu_count[otu_count == 1])
length(unique_otus)

#Keep only otus present in 1 sample
B_ps_unique_otus <- prune_taxa(unique_otus, B_remove_empty1_ps)

#remove empty samples
B_ps_unique_otus_c<-prune_samples(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus)>0, B_ps_unique_otus)

#distribution of counts of unique otus
print("sample counts of unique otus")
summary(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus_c))

#sort sums from low to high
sort(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus_c))
```

#check relative abundance of unique OTUs
```{r}
#calculate relative abundance of OTUs
ps_rel_abundance <- transform_sample_counts(B_remove_empty1_ps, function(x) x*100/ sum(x))

#extract otu table
otu_table <- otu_table(ps_rel_abundance)

#Count number of samples each OTU is present in
otu_count <- rowSums(otu_table >0)

#Select OTU IDs present in exactly 1 samples and count how many
unique_otus <- names(otu_count[otu_count == 1])
length(unique_otus)

#Keep only otus present in 1 sample
B_ps_unique_otus <- prune_taxa(unique_otus, ps_rel_abundance)

#remove empty samples
B_ps_unique_otus_c<-prune_samples(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus)>0, B_ps_unique_otus)

#distribution of unique otus
print("sample counts of unique otus")
summary(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus_c))

#sort sums from low to high
sort(sample_sums(B_ps_unique_otus_c))
```

#filter by prevalence (remove OTUs present in only 1 sample)
```{r}
#isolate otu table
otu_table<-otu_table(B_remove_empty1_ps)

#check number of taxa
print("number of taxa")
nrow(otu_table)

#remove low prevalent taxa
clean_otu1 <- otu_table[rowSums(otu_table > 0) >= 2, ]

#check number of taxa
print("number of taxa left")
nrow(clean_otu1)
print("number of taxa removed")
nrow(otu_table)-nrow(clean_otu1)

#view empty samples (won't run when no empty samples)
empty_samples<-clean_otu1[,colSums(clean_otu1)<1]
colnames(empty_samples)

#remove empty samples
clean_otu2<- clean_otu1[,colSums(clean_otu1)>0]

#look at feature and sample distribution
print("feature counts distribution")
summary(rowSums(clean_otu2))

print("feature counts in samples distribution")
summary(colSums(clean_otu2))

#update phyloseq
otu_table(B_remove_empty1_ps)<-clean_otu2
B_remove_empty1_ps
```

#Filter out contaminants
```{r}
#separate metadata
B_filter_ps <- B_remove_empty1_ps
sample_data<-sample_data(B_filter_ps)

#change all negative controls to "Neg"
sample_data$Subject_id<-gsub("NEG", "Neg",sample_data$Subject_id)

#update phyloseq object
sample_data(B_filter_ps)<-sample_data

#identify negative controls and creates an "is.neg column
sample_data(B_filter_ps)$is.neg <- sample_data(B_filter_ps)$Subject_id == "Neg"

#filter contaminants based on prevalence in negative controls in comparison to samples
B_contamdf.prev <- isContaminant(B_filter_ps, method = "prevalence", neg= "is.neg")

print("number of contaminant taxa")
table(B_contamdf.prev$contaminant)

#prune taxa to only contain non-contaminated sequences
print("after contaminant cleaning")
B_ps.noncontam <- prune_taxa(!B_contamdf.prev$contaminant, B_filter_ps)
B_ps.noncontam
```

#View contaminated taxa
```{r}
#extract contaminant taxa (TRUE)
B_contaminants <- rownames(B_contamdf.prev[B_contamdf.prev$contaminant == TRUE, ])

#Extract taxonomy for contaminant taxa
B_contaminant_taxa <- tax_table(B_filter_ps)[B_contaminants, ]

#view counts of contaminants across samples before removal
names<-rownames(B_contaminant_taxa) 
count_present<-clean_otu2[rownames(clean_otu2) %in% names, ]
total_count_present<-rowSums(count_present)
total_count_present
summary(total_count_present)

#view taxonomy of contaminants
print("contaminant taxa")
B_contaminant_taxa
```

#check resulting phyloseq object
B_no_controls <- sample_data(B_ps_clean)$Subject_id
B_no_controls
B_ps_clean

#Prepare for normalization
#check if sample types have different sampling depths
```{r}
B_ps_counts<-B_sample_analysis

#extract otu table and sum total counts
otu_counts<-otu_table(B_ps_counts)

#sum feature count for each sample
total_counts<-colSums(otu_counts)
summary(total_counts)

#combine metadata with total counts
metadata<-sample_data(B_ps_counts)
metadata$counts<-total_counts

#make sure counts are numeric
metadata$counts<-as.numeric(metadata$counts)

#list comparisons for wilcox test
comparisons<- list(c("Intact_skin","Wound"))

#visualize difference in counts
B_swab_type_counts<-ggplot(metadata, aes(x=Swab_type, y=counts, fill=Swab_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(title = "Swab type count Distribution", x = "Swab_type", y = "Total Counts", fill="Swab_type")+
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     size = 4,
                    comparisons = comparisons)
B_swab_type_counts
```

#all samples: rarefaction
```{r}
#switch columns and header names
df_matrix <- as.matrix(clean_otu_c)
c_flipped_clean_otu <- t(df_matrix)
c_flipped_clean_otu<-as.data.frame(c_flipped_clean_otu)

#check changes
c_flipped_clean_otu

#determine the minimum total number of individuals
min_sample_size<- min(rowSums(c_flipped_clean_otu))
min_sample_size

#generate multiple rarefied OTU table (3 different sub-samples)
B_rarefied_otu_data1 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
B_rarefied_otu_data2 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
B_rarefied_otu_data3 <- vegan::rrarefy(c_flipped_clean_otu, min_sample_size)
```

#merge to genus level

#Wound samples: non-rarefied cutoff minimum for wound samples
```{r}
#Add a different number for all NA in Genus
Genus_unknown<-B_ps_nr_min23000

# Extract the taxonomy table from the phyloseq object
tax_table_cleaned <- as.data.frame(tax_table(Genus_unknown))

# Add a unique number to the NA values in the Phylum column
tax_table_cleaned$Genus[is.na(tax_table_cleaned$Genus)] <- paste("Unknown_genus", seq_along(tax_table_cleaned$Genus[is.na(tax_table_cleaned$Genus)]), sep="_")

# Update the taxonomy table in the phyloseq object
tax_table(Genus_unknown) <- as.matrix(tax_table_cleaned)

#Filter only unique Genus names (merge species with same names)
unique_genus<-tax_glom(Genus_unknown, taxrank="Genus")

B_ps_nr_min23000genus<-unique_genus

print("B_ps_nr_min23000")
B_ps_nr_min23000
print("B_ps_nr_min23000genus")
B_ps_nr_min23000genus
```
